verses.text: A song of ascents. When I was in trouble, I cried out to the LORD, and he answered me.
LORD, save me from lying lips and tongues that twist the truth.
What will you get for this? What else is coming to you, you lying tongue?
Sharp arrows from a warrior, along with burning juniper coals.
What misery, living as a stranger in Meshech, staying among the tents of Kedar!
I’ve lived way too long with people who hate peace.
I’m for peace, but the moment I speak, they’re ready for war.
